Earthquake of magnitude 5.3-5.6 strikes Nepal, tremors felt across India

An earthquake with a magnitude ranging from 5.3 to 5.6 struck Nepal's Koshi Province on Tuesday. Tremors were felt across various parts of India, including Sikkim, Bihar, West Bengal, and Meghalaya, as well as in Bhutan and Bangladesh. The epicentre was reported to be near the China border in some accounts. There were no immediate reports of damage.
